+import json
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import unittest
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
+SCRIPT = ROOT / "count.py"
+
+
+class CountCliTests(unittest.TestCase):
+    def run_cli(self, *args):
+        return subprocess.run(
+            [sys.executable, str(SCRIPT), *args],
+            capture_output=True,
+            text=True,
+            cwd=ROOT,
+        )
+
+    def test_default_count(self):
+        result = self.run_cli()
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "0 widgets\n")
+        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "")
+
+    def test_positive_integer(self):
+        result = self.run_cli("3")
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "3 widgets\n")
+        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "")
+
+    def test_negative_integer(self):
+        result = self.run_cli("-2")
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "-2 widgets\n")
+        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "")
+
+    def test_json_default(self):
+        result = self.run_cli("--json")
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout), {"widgets": 0})
+        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "")
+
+    def test_json_flag_before_count(self):
+        result = self.run_cli("--json", "5")
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout), {"widgets": 5})
+        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "")
+
+    def test_json_flag_after_count(self):
+        result = self.run_cli("5", "--json")
+        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(json.loads(result.stdout), {"widgets": 5})
+        self.assertEqual(result.stderr, "")
+
+    def test_invalid_non_integer(self):
+        result = self.run_cli("abc")
+        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
+        self.assertTrue(result.stderr.strip())
+        self.assertNotIn("Traceback", result.stderr)
+
+    def test_invalid_extra_argument(self):
+        result = self.run_cli("1", "2")
+        self.assertNotEqual(result.returncode, 0)
+        self.assertEqual(result.stdout, "")
+        self.assertTrue(result.stderr.strip())
+        self.assertNotIn("Traceback", result.stderr)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
